whyPeopleLook: Poke got the interface right: talk to an assistant where you already chat. The Interaction Company built something people liked, Apple approved it as the first AI agent on Messages for Business, and Cognition acquired the company in July 2026. People searching for a Poke alternative usually want to keep the texting habit while gaining what a chat thread cannot hold: a full app when the work gets long, workflows they can see and edit, control over memory, and code they can inspect.
